cells.tense: The strength is moving between people right now, and it is arriving where it is needed.
cells.act: choose which star to steer by and steer
cells.ask: Choose what you will carry forward — a practice, a person, a piece of history — and this week put your hands on it, not your survey.
cells.core:
You can hold a thing up and hand it on. What you have, you pass to whoever needs it, and the passing keeps it alive. Someone leaves with more than they came with because you stood there steady and shared what you had. That is the whole work: strength moving between people, spent on what matters rather than held.

What is free to feed next is direction. You can pick a heading — a practice, a person, a piece of history worth keeping — and give it your whole hands instead of half-attention here and there. The passing works better when it knows where it is going. Name the one thing this week and carry it deliberately; the rest can wait.
cells.sheetLine: You pass strength along, and it keeps people standing.
cells.verb: passing strength along to whoever is holding something up
cells.place: where meaning is carried forward between people — the habits, words and practices handed down and kept alive

cells.tense: The sharing is running past itself, handing out strength before anyone has asked for it.
cells.act: return the small thing you owe before anyone asks
cells.ask: Think of a small debt you carry — a return, a favor, ground you took — and settle it before anyone asks.
cells.core:
Sharing here can outrun the asking. Strength gets given before it is needed, pushed at people who did not reach, and what was support starts to feel like weight. The deciding happens before the moment arrives, for a future that has not come. What was holding turns into carrying that nobody requested.

Your inner sense of what is fair is the way back, and it does not need an audience. Somewhere in all this giving there is a small imbalance you have not settled — a thing owed, a share not returned, a claim you quietly hold. Find it and pay it where no one is watching. Fairness returns when the flow stops being one-directional and starts being exchange again, and exchange comes back one honest, private payment at a time.
cells.sheetLine: You hand out strength faster than anyone can take it.

cells.tense: The sharing stopped and the person stood at that door and stayed there.
cells.act: engage the hard part on purpose and see what holds
cells.ask: Pick the part of this you have been avoiding — the difficult conversation, the unglamorous work, the commitment that keeps costing — and walk into it this week. See what holds.
cells.core:
Where meaning is carried between people, not much is moving lately. The strength to share is real and present, and it is going nowhere. Standing back feels safer than reaching in, and the backing away has become the habit. Nothing new is being passed on. The hands that could hold something up are staying in pockets.

What returns this is not trying harder to care. It is walking straight into the part you have been avoiding and letting the friction tell you what you are actually committed to. Choose the hard conversation, the unglamorous task, the thing that costs. Do it once. What survives the doing is the commitment, and what falls away was only the method. This comes back after you have been tested, not before.

cells.tense: You are carrying meaning forward between people, and your account of it is that you are simply present.
cells.act: turn toward the one direction and stop surveying
cells.ask: Name what you will carry forward — the reading, the habit, the person — and give your attention there only, letting the other surveys go.
cells.core:
Something is being kept alive here because you keep it, and you would say you were just there when it happened. None of your part is being named as work. The meaning that gets passed between people gets passed through you. Your version has you as terrain rather than builder.

Before all this, you chose a direction and walked. Not because it made sense, because it pulled. Choose the heading again, plainly — the thing you will actually carry forward, chosen because you want it. Turning toward it, rather than weighing every option evenly, is where this began for you. The single direction makes the passing possible, and you get to name your part in it.
